div.p: Este case-sensitive sistema de código https://fhir.heartlandprotocol.org/CodeSystem/heartland-risk-score define o seguinte códigos:

tr.td: Total of the HEARTLAND risk score, 0 to 18 points. Carried as Observation.valueInteger. A heuristic point count, not a probability.
Qualitative tier derived from the total. Carried as a CodeableConcept drawn from the HeartlandRiskTier code system, typically as an Observation component of the score.

description.value: Codes identifying the HEARTLAND risk score and its tier when either is carried on an Observation rather than on a RiskAssessment — for example an Observation referenced from HeartlandRiskAssessment.basis holding the point total. The score is a non-validated implementation heuristic: the total is a point count, not a probability, and the tier assigns monitoring intensity rather than predicting an outcome.

definition.value: Total of the HEARTLAND risk score, 0 to 18 points. Carried as Observation.valueInteger. A heuristic point count, not a probability.
Qualitative tier derived from the total. Carried as a CodeableConcept drawn from the HeartlandRiskTier code system, typically as an Observation component of the score.
